name: veed
description: Agentic AI Video Creation — drop-in skills that teach your agent to make video with VEED. Talking heads (audio-driven and text-driven), styled subtitles, and background removal, powered by VEED's APIs on Fal.

interface.shortDescription: Agentic AI video creation — talking heads, subtitles, background removal
interface.longDescription: VEED Skills give your agent the ability to create video without leaving the chat. Use /veed:talking-head and /veed:talking-head-text to animate any photo into a lip-synced presenter (audio file or generated speech from text), /veed:subtitles to burn styled captions onto any video with 27 visual presets and auto-transcription in 125+ languages, and /veed:background-removal to extract subjects with three modes (standard, fast, green screen). All skills run on VEED's APIs via Fal.
defaultPrompt: Animate this photo to lip-sync this audio: [image] + [audio]
Make this photo say 'Welcome to our store' in a confident British accent
Add animated subtitles to this video using the glass preset
Remove the background from this video
